The case is decided as **auto-fix**, to the coder.

The investigator traced the crash to `OrderApi.GetOrderTotal` in `src/OrderService/Api/OrderTotal.cs`, line 18. Order 1003 carries the retired code `SUMMER25`, which is not in the discount table (only `WELCOME10` and `VIP20`), so the `DiscountRates[order.DiscountCode]` lookup throws. The investigator rated the cause as code, with high confidence. That matches the runbook row for a certain crash in this method's code caused by a retired discount code. The expected fix is to give no discount (total = subtotal) for an unknown code, and to leave the totals for `WELCOME10`, `VIP20` and no-code orders unchanged.

I could not brief the coder directly, because my list of callable agents covers only the sorter, investigator and reviewer. The auto-fix decision is recorded with the cause, file and expected behaviour, so the coder has what it needs from the run. The reviewer will be briefed once a fix comes back on its branch.
